label: URL Alias Binding
type: sibling of eventing:binding - a handler can only curl() a URL with a pre-configured URL Alias binding pointing at it
note: Consolidates two independent mints of the same concept: 'eventing:url-binding' and 'eventing:url-alias-binding' - kept the fuller name since it matches the literal UI/docs term found in evidence ('Needs a Binding of type URL Alias'). Its 'misc.' settings column value 'no auth' implies other auth modes exist for this binding type, none documented on the pages read this round - left as an open question, not resolved.
